_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0-for-52 base rate on directional moves over 7 days makes HOLD the only statistically defensible call in this coil, with the analyst's macro divergences (Fed liquidity at 0, ETF flows at 0, VIX at 69) overriding the narrative's bullish stablecoin signal as a reason to force a directional bet.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — both call HOLD as base case, but analyst frames it as post-recovery stall with no fuel for breakout while narrative frames it as accumulation coil resolving upward; the analyst's higher trust weight and stronger factor evidence carry the lean toward continued HOLD.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows break above 30 AND funding drops below 40 with BTC holding above $62K — this would validate the narrative's accumulation thesis and shift phase to Disbelief with LONG signal
